rows.quote: To address this gap, we performed antibody-based proteomic profiling using Olink technology [11] across four key cardiometabolic tissues (liver, skeletal muscle, aorta and mammary artery), assaying 1,242 samples from 284 patients in the Stockholm-Tartu Atherosclerosis Reverse Engineering Task (STARNET) cohort [14,15].
rows.coder_note: Sentence names proteomic profiling of samples from the STARNET cohort as the protein data used; no dictionary pQTL row for it.
